stages.validation_method: Executive challenge session and traceability from strategy choices to measurable outcomes.
stages.purpose: turn business intent into measurable strategic choices
execution_instructions: State the business problem, affected customer groups and strategic time horizon.
Assess market forces, internal capabilities, dependencies and external constraints using cited evidence.
Compare at least two strategic options, including a no-change baseline, with assumptions and trade-offs.
Define outcome metrics, leading indicators, investment hypotheses and review triggers.
quality_criteria: Each strategic choice has evidence, trade-offs and an accountable owner.
Metrics have baseline, target, measurement source and review cadence.
Unvalidated assumptions are explicit rather than presented as facts.

stages.validation_method: Independent source sampling, arithmetic reconciliation and stakeholder challenge of assumptions.
stages.purpose: validate a market opportunity with traceable external evidence
execution_instructions: Define research questions, target geography, customer segment, time horizon and decision the research must support.
Collect primary and secondary evidence; record source URL, publication date, sample, methodology and conflicts of interest.
Compare competitors, substitutes, pricing and market signals; separate observed facts from estimates and assumptions.
Synthesize opportunity, risks, confidence limits and unanswered questions into a decision brief.
quality_criteria: Every material claim traces to a dated source or is labelled an assumption.
Market size states method, units, geography and confidence range.
Recommendation identifies disconfirming evidence and research gaps.

inputs: statement of need and current commitments
stages.validation_method: Client confirmation of decisions and review by the accountable engagement owner.
stages.purpose: establish an agreed client outcome and a controlled decision trail
execution_instructions: Map sponsor, users, approvers and operational contacts; identify who can accept scope, cost and risk.
Run a structured discovery conversation and capture needs, constraints, success measures and unresolved questions.
Record commitments, decision owners, dates and changes in a client decision log; do not treat informal discussion as approval.
Confirm the agreed next action, accountable owner and acceptance route with the client.
quality_criteria: Every commitment has an owner and due date.
Client acceptance and internal approval are distinguishable.
Conflicting expectations are recorded and escalated before scope is baselined.

stages.validation_method: Product owner review of evidence and explicit decision record.
stages.purpose: reduce product uncertainty before committing delivery capacity
execution_instructions: Frame the user problem without prescribing a solution; identify affected segments and frequency/severity.
Gather interview, support, analytics and workflow evidence; document sample limitations and contradictory signals.
Generate solution hypotheses and design low-cost experiments that can falsify them.
Rank opportunities by user value, confidence, effort and strategic fit; recommend proceed, pivot or stop.
quality_criteria: Each proposed solution links to a validated user problem.
Experiments have a falsifiable hypothesis, metric, sample and decision threshold.
A stop or pivot decision is accepted as a valid discovery outcome.

stages.validation_method: Walkthrough with process owners and affected users.
stages.purpose: translate business needs into process and decision requirements
execution_instructions: Map current actors, events, inputs, decisions, exceptions and downstream outcomes.
Identify process pain points, business rules, data ownership and control points.
Model the proposed state and compare impacts, dependencies and exception paths.
Trace each requirement to a business objective and a measurable acceptance condition.
quality_criteria: Process paths include normal, exception and failure cases.
Rules have an owner and source.
Requirements are testable and trace to a business outcome.

stages.validation_method: Product and delivery leadership review.
stages.purpose: convert product outcomes into a sequenced and measurable roadmap
execution_instructions: Define roadmap themes around outcomes rather than feature lists.
Sequence initiatives by value, confidence, dependency, risk and capacity.
Set measurable success metrics and explicit assumptions for each horizon.
Identify decision checkpoints and conditions that change priority.
quality_criteria: Every roadmap item has an outcome, owner and success measure.
Dependencies and confidence are visible.
Dates are not represented as commitments without capacity and approval.

stages.validation_method: Independent architecture, security and finance challenge.
stages.purpose: test whether a proposed initiative is viable within real constraints
execution_instructions: Assess technical fit, skills, integration, data availability and operational supportability.
Estimate delivery, migration, licensing, hosting and ongoing support costs with ranges.
Identify legal, privacy, security, accessibility and supplier constraints.
Run a bounded proof or research spike for high-risk unknowns; record proceed/conditional/stop recommendation.
quality_criteria: Critical assumptions have evidence or a time-boxed validation plan.
Total lifecycle cost is considered, not just build cost.
Recommendation names constraints and decision owner.

stages.validation_method: Finance review and independent arithmetic check.
stages.purpose: produce a transparent estimate and funding baseline
execution_instructions: Break work into measurable cost drivers and separate one-time from recurring spend.
Estimate effort, infrastructure, licensing, vendor, migration and support costs using ranges.
Document confidence, exclusions, currency, tax treatment and contingency basis.
Reconcile the estimate against available funding and define variance thresholds.
quality_criteria: Totals recalculate from traceable line items.
Uncertainty and contingency are visible.
Estimate owner and approval authority are named.

stages.validation_method: Independent approval record and audit trail.
stages.purpose: prepare a controlled decision with sufficient evidence and independent authority
execution_instructions: Check the decision request is complete, in scope and owned by an authorized requester.
Evaluate acceptance evidence, residual risks, dependencies, rollback/recovery readiness and affected parties.
Record independent reviewer input and unresolved objections; do not approve work you personally verified where segregation is required.
Issue approve, reject, defer or conditional decision with conditions, expiry and accountable approver.
quality_criteria: Decision authority is verified.
Conditions are measurable, owned and time-bound.
No missing or failed critical evidence is silently waived.
stages.approval_rationale: Commits budget and staff to the project on the organization's behalf; only the sponsor may authorize that.

stages.validation_method: Legal and compliance owner sign-off.
stages.purpose: review contractual and regulatory obligations before commitment
execution_instructions: Identify service, data, security, availability, audit, retention, subcontracting and exit obligations.
Map each obligation to an internal control owner and evidence source.
Flag ambiguous liability, data processing, IP, jurisdiction, renewal and termination terms.
Record legal review questions and do not provide legal approval outside delegated authority.
quality_criteria: Every material obligation has an owner and evidence path.
Exceptions have an authorized risk owner.
Unresolved legal interpretation is escalated.
stages.approval_rationale: Accepting contract terms creates legal obligations; the legal owner must approve before commitment.

stages.validation_method: Stakeholder playback and confirmation.
stages.purpose: discover complete and testable stakeholder needs
execution_instructions: Select interviews, workshops, observation or document analysis appropriate to each stakeholder.
Ask for goals, tasks, exceptions, pain points, constraints and examples of successful outcomes.
Resolve conflicting statements by recording source, authority and decision owner.
Convert findings into candidate requirements and confirm them with the source stakeholder.
quality_criteria: Needs are attributed to a source and context.
Conflicts and assumptions remain visible.
Coverage includes exceptions and operational users.

stages.validation_method: Peer review by product, engineering and QA.
stages.purpose: create a navigable, versioned and traceable specification
execution_instructions: Organize scope, actors, terminology, requirements, constraints, dependencies and exclusions.
Assign stable IDs and link each requirement to source, owner and downstream tests.
Document diagrams, examples, exceptions and unresolved decisions in the repository convention.
Review clarity, consistency, links, version and change history.
quality_criteria: No ambiguous pronouns or unbounded terms remain in normative requirements.
IDs are stable and traceable.
Links, diagrams and examples render.

stages.validation_method: Scenario walkthrough with developer and tester.
stages.purpose: specify observable system behavior and business rules
execution_instructions: Write behavior using actor, trigger, precondition, main flow, alternate flow and postcondition.
Define validation, state transitions, error responses and idempotency where applicable.
Derive positive, negative, boundary and authorization acceptance cases.
Trace each behavior to a requirement ID and owner.
quality_criteria: Each requirement has observable expected behavior.
Boundary and failure cases are covered.
No implementation detail is mistaken for a user outcome.

stages.validation_method: Review each NFR for measurable thresholds and verify test plans can produce the required evidence.
stages.purpose: quantify reliability, performance, security and operability expectations
execution_instructions: Select relevant quality attributes such as latency, throughput, availability, recovery, scalability, privacy and accessibility.
Set thresholds with percentile, workload, duration, measurement point and acceptable error rate.
Define telemetry and test conditions needed to verify each target.
Resolve trade-offs among quality attributes and obtain product/operations owner acceptance.
quality_criteria: Every NFR has a threshold, workload condition and verification method.
Targets are measurable and tied to business criticality.
Trade-offs and owners are explicit.

stages.validation_method: Research peer review and stakeholder playback.
stages.purpose: collect ethical and representative evidence about user behavior
execution_instructions: Recruit participants against explicit inclusion criteria and record sampling limitations.
Obtain consent; avoid collecting unnecessary personal or sensitive data.
Run neutral interviews or observations with consistent prompts and session notes.
Code findings into themes, counterexamples and confidence levels; distinguish participant statements from researcher inference.
quality_criteria: Research question maps to evidence.
Sampling bias and limitations are disclosed.
Recommendations do not overgeneralize beyond the sample.

stages.validation_method: Product/design review and quick usability walkthrough.
stages.purpose: explore information hierarchy and interaction structure before visual polish
execution_instructions: Identify primary tasks and content hierarchy for each screen.
Create low-fidelity layouts with navigation, states, responsive behavior and annotations.
Review task completion paths, empty/error/loading states and keyboard flow.
Record design decisions and unresolved usability questions.
quality_criteria: Wireframes cover all critical states and target viewports.
Labels and navigation support user goals.
No decorative styling hides missing behavior.

stages.validation_method: Design-system review and accessibility check.
stages.purpose: define a consistent and accessible visual interface
execution_instructions: Apply typography, color, spacing, hierarchy and component states using the design system.
Specify responsive behavior, focus/hover/disabled/error states and asset usage.
Check color contrast, text scaling and semantic component intent.
Document deviations and reusable component decisions.
quality_criteria: Visual states and responsive breakpoints are specified.
Contrast and text scaling meet agreed standards.
Components reuse approved tokens or record justified exceptions.

stages.validation_method: Moderated usability review.
stages.purpose: optimize task completion, comprehension and error recovery
execution_instructions: Design navigation, information scent, feedback, affordances and error recovery around user tasks.
Cover first-use, repeat-use, empty, loading, failure and recovery states.
Prototype critical paths and observe representative users.
Revise based on task success, time, error and qualitative feedback.
quality_criteria: Critical tasks have clear entry, progress and recovery.
Usability issues are prioritized by impact.
Design changes are linked to research evidence.

stages.validation_method: Product/design decision review.
stages.purpose: validate a risky interaction or concept before production implementation
execution_instructions: Choose fidelity that answers the question without implying production readiness.
Build only the critical path and realistic states needed for the experiment.
Run task-based sessions and capture observations, failures and time-on-task.
Decide iterate, validate further or discard; label simulated behavior and data.
quality_criteria: Prototype limitations are explicit.
Success criteria are measured.
No prototype-only behavior is represented as production capability.

stages.validation_method: Independent accessibility specialist review.
stages.purpose: verify inclusive access against applicable WCAG criteria
execution_instructions: Inspect semantic structure, accessible names, headings, landmarks, labels and error associations.
Test keyboard-only operation, focus order/visibility, dialogs and escape behavior.
Check contrast, zoom/reflow, reduced motion and screen-reader announcements.
Combine automated scans with manual assistive-technology testing; log criterion-level failures.
quality_criteria: Automated scans are not treated as full conformance proof.
Critical journeys work without pointer input.
Findings cite criterion, impact and reproduction.

stages.validation_method: Cross-functional requirements review.
stages.purpose: prove requirements are complete, consistent, feasible and testable
execution_instructions: Check each requirement for atomicity, necessity, clarity, feasibility and verifiability.
Trace business goals to requirements, design elements and test cases.
Run ambiguity, conflict, duplication and orphan checks.
Resolve or explicitly defer findings with owners before baseline approval.
quality_criteria: No critical orphan, conflict or untestable requirement remains.
Stakeholders approve the baseline version.
Deferred items have owner and impact.

stages.validation_method: Architecture review against documented quality attribute scenarios.
stages.purpose: define the system structure and component boundaries for the target quality attributes
execution_instructions: Define system context, actors, external systems and trust boundaries.
Decompose capabilities into components and assign ownership, interfaces and dependency direction.
Evaluate synchronous/asynchronous boundaries, data ownership, failure isolation and deployment topology.
Compare architecture options against latency, availability, scalability, security, operability and cost scenarios.
quality_criteria: Every component has responsibility and owner.
Dependencies and failure domains are explicit.
Trade-offs are tied to measurable quality scenarios.

stages.validation_method: DBA, security and application owner review.
stages.purpose: design durable data structures and safe evolution strategy
execution_instructions: Model entities, keys, constraints, cardinality and transactional boundaries.
Evaluate indexes, query patterns, partitioning, consistency and growth assumptions.
Define retention, encryption, access boundaries, backup and recovery strategy.
Plan additive migration, backfill, compatibility window and rollback/forward-fix path.
quality_criteria: Integrity constraints are enforceable.
Performance decisions are workload-backed.
Migration and restore path are rehearsable.

stages.validation_method: API consumer and security architecture review.
stages.purpose: design stable API resources, contracts and compatibility policy
execution_instructions: Model resources, identifiers, relationships, pagination, filtering and lifecycle semantics.
Define OpenAPI schemas, required/optional fields, validation, error envelope and idempotency behavior.
Specify authentication, authorization, rate limits, versioning and deprecation policy.
Assess consumer migration and generate contract compatibility checks.
quality_criteria: Contract is machine-valid and has representative examples.
Breaking changes and consumer impact are identified.
Auth/error/idempotency behavior is explicit.

stages.validation_method: Cloud security and operations design review.
stages.purpose: design a secure, resilient and supportable cloud landing pattern
execution_instructions: Choose regions, network zones, identity boundaries and managed services against requirements.
Model failure domains, autoscaling, backup, observability and deployment topology.
Define policy-as-code, encryption, key ownership and secret integration.
Estimate lifecycle cost and document portability/vendor lock-in trade-offs.
quality_criteria: Failure domains align with RTO/RPO.
IAM and network boundaries are least privilege.
Cost assumptions and service quotas are explicit.

stages.validation_method: Independent security architecture review.
stages.purpose: define trust boundaries and security controls before implementation
execution_instructions: Identify assets, entry points, identities, trust boundaries and privileged operations.
Model abuse cases and threats using a documented method such as STRIDE where suitable.
Map preventive, detective and recovery controls to threats and owners.
Record residual risk, security assumptions and verification requirements.
quality_criteria: High-impact threats have treatment and owner.
Trust boundaries and data flows are complete.
Controls have testable verification evidence.

stages.validation_method: Data governance council review.
stages.purpose: govern data domains, semantics, lineage and lifecycle
execution_instructions: Define domain entities, canonical terms, identifiers and system-of-record ownership.
Map ingestion, transformation, sharing, lineage and quality responsibility.
Set classification, access, retention, deletion and residency rules.
Review interoperability and schema evolution with producers and consumers.
quality_criteria: Critical elements have owners and definitions.
Lineage covers source-to-consumer flow.
Privacy and retention controls are enforceable.

stages.validation_method: Producer, consumer and operations review.
stages.purpose: design reliable boundaries between independently operated systems
execution_instructions: Select synchronous or asynchronous interaction based on coupling and latency needs.
Define schema, correlation IDs, idempotency, retries, ordering and dead-letter behavior.
Specify authentication, secrets, rate limits, observability and contract evolution.
Test timeout, duplicate, partial failure and partner outage scenarios.
quality_criteria: Every interface has owner and version policy.
Retries cannot create unsafe duplicate side effects.
Failure handling and telemetry are specified.

stages.validation_method: Architecture governance review.
stages.purpose: choose technology through evidence-based trade-off analysis
execution_instructions: Define decision criteria and weights before scoring candidates.
Evaluate functional fit, integration, maturity, security, licensing, operability and exit cost.
Prototype only uncertain high-impact capabilities and record measured results.
Publish decision, rejected alternatives, assumptions and review trigger.
quality_criteria: Scoring criteria are transparent.
Total cost and exit strategy are included.
Decision is reproducible from evidence.

stages.validation_method: Architecture peer review.
stages.purpose: publish architecture decisions and models for future operators
execution_instructions: Document context, scope, constraints, component boundaries and data/control flows.
Link ADRs, interfaces, deployment topology, quality attributes and known limitations.
Keep diagrams source-controlled and validate rendering and links.
Assign owners and review triggers for decisions that can become stale.
quality_criteria: Documentation matches deployed reality.
Every key decision has rationale and alternatives.
Owners and freshness triggers are defined.

stages.validation_method: Sponsor approval.
stages.purpose: establish project authority, outcomes and operating cadence
execution_instructions: Confirm sponsor, project manager, decision rights and escalation path.
Define objectives, measurable outcomes, scope, exclusions and success criteria.
Set governance cadence, reporting, change control and initial RAID ownership.
Baseline charter and mobilization actions.
quality_criteria: Accountability and authority are explicit.
Outcomes and scope are measurable.
Open assumptions have owners and due dates.

stages.validation_method: Delivery manager and functional owner review.
stages.purpose: match capacity and specialist skills to the delivery demand
execution_instructions: Build role-based capacity by iteration and critical skill.
Identify bottlenecks, single points of failure and onboarding lead time.
Compare demand with available capacity and propose sequencing or sourcing options.
Track actual allocation and reforecast when assumptions change.
quality_criteria: Plan uses available capacity, not nominal headcount.
Critical skill gaps have mitigations.
Allocation changes are approved.

stages.validation_method: Cross-functional planning review.
stages.purpose: decompose approved scope into estimable and verifiable work
execution_instructions: Decompose deliverables into work packages with clear boundaries and owners.
Identify dependencies, integration points, external approvals and critical path.
Define acceptance evidence and estimate-ready assumptions for each package.
Review decomposition with delivery and technical owners before estimating.
quality_criteria: Every scope item maps to a work package.
No package is too broad to estimate or verify.
Dependencies and ownership are explicit.

stages.validation_method: Finance review and independent arithmetic check.
stages.purpose: produce a transparent estimate and funding baseline
execution_instructions: Break work into measurable cost drivers and separate one-time from recurring spend.
Estimate effort, infrastructure, licensing, vendor, migration and support costs using ranges.
Document confidence, exclusions, currency, tax treatment and contingency basis.
Reconcile the estimate against available funding and define variance thresholds.
quality_criteria: Totals recalculate from traceable line items.
Uncertainty and contingency are visible.
Estimate owner and approval authority are named.

stages.validation_method: Team planning agreement.
stages.purpose: select a feasible sprint goal and commitment
execution_instructions: Confirm sprint objective and business value before selecting stories.
Check readiness, acceptance criteria, dependencies, test data and external blockers.
Forecast capacity using recent throughput and actual availability.
Split work to deliver testable increments and agree a contingency buffer.
quality_criteria: Commitment fits actual capacity.
Stories meet readiness criteria.
Sprint goal is outcome-focused and measurable.

inputs: team working agreement and iteration goal
work item state and cycle-time data
stages.validation_method: Team retrospective and delivery review.
stages.purpose: make delivery flow visible and remove impediments
execution_instructions: Inspect flow, work in progress, aging items and blocked time rather than relying on status adjectives.
Facilitate planning/review/retro with decisions and owners.
Escalate cross-team impediments and resolve dependency sequencing.
Use trend data to adapt scope and forecast without pressuring unsafe shortcuts.
quality_criteria: Work state reflects evidence.
Impediments have owners and next actions.
Metrics are used for improvement, not individual surveillance.

stages.validation_method: Risk owner and governance review.
stages.purpose: identify, quantify and actively treat delivery and operational risks
execution_instructions: Describe each risk as cause-event-impact and distinguish it from an issue.
Score likelihood and impact using the agreed scale; identify exposure and trigger.
Select avoid, mitigate, transfer or accept treatment with owner and due date.
Reassess residual risk and escalate threshold breaches.
quality_criteria: High risks have active treatments and triggers.
Risk acceptance is authorized and time-bound.
Issues are not hidden as risks.

stages.validation_method: Sponsor and stakeholder review.
stages.purpose: align decision-makers and affected parties through the lifecycle
execution_instructions: Identify decision authority, affected users, veto points and information needs.
Set communication cadence and channel by stakeholder group.
Capture decisions, concerns, commitments and unresolved conflicts.
Escalate missing decisions before they block downstream work.
quality_criteria: Every key decision has an owner and due date.
Affected parties are informed before impact.
Conflicts are resolved or explicitly escalated.

stages.validation_method: Change authority approval.
stages.purpose: control scope, configuration or organizational change safely
execution_instructions: Classify change type, urgency, blast radius and reversibility.
Assess schedule, cost, architecture, security, data, user and operational impacts.
Update affected baselines, plans and traceability only after approval.
Communicate decision and verify adoption or post-change outcome.
quality_criteria: No unapproved baseline change is treated as accepted.
Rollback and communication needs are considered.
Impact owners have reviewed the change.
stages.approval_rationale: Approving a change request alters committed scope, cost or schedule; the change board decides, not the requester.

stages.validation_method: Repository owner and security review.
stages.purpose: establish a secure and reproducible engineering workspace
execution_instructions: Inspect repository state, ownership, package manifests, existing CI and local instructions before changes.
Define branch protection, review ownership, required checks, reproducible setup and supported toolchain.
Keep credentials out of source; use approved secret storage and least-privilege access.
Add onboarding and contribution guidance, then validate from a clean checkout.
quality_criteria: A clean contributor can reproduce setup.
Protected branches require review and checks.
No secret value is committed.

inputs: API contracts and browser support matrix
stages.validation_method: UI peer review and browser test run.
stages.purpose: implement accessible client behavior and resilient interface states
execution_instructions: Inspect routing, state management, component conventions and existing design system.
Implement semantic components, responsive layout, keyboard behavior and loading/empty/error states.
Integrate typed or validated API boundaries and handle cancellation/retry safely.
Add component and browser tests for critical interactions; verify accessibility and console/network errors.
quality_criteria: Critical flows work at supported viewports.
Keyboard and screen-reader semantics are preserved.
No unhandled errors or leaked async state.

stages.validation_method: Code review and service integration tests.
stages.purpose: implement service behavior with explicit contracts and operational controls
execution_instructions: Trace request handling through validation, domain logic, persistence and response mapping.
Enforce authentication/authorization at the service boundary and avoid trusting client fields.
Implement transaction, idempotency, timeout, retry and error semantics appropriate to side effects.
Add unit/integration tests, structured logs and metrics without sensitive payloads.
quality_criteria: Authorization is server-side.
Failure paths do not leak secrets or corrupt state.
Tests cover boundaries and duplicate requests.

stages.validation_method: Cross-layer code review and E2E test.
stages.purpose: deliver a coherent vertical slice across UI, service and persistence
execution_instructions: Trace the user journey across UI, API, domain service and persistence before editing.
Define compatible request/response and state transitions across layers.
Implement one end-to-end slice with validation, authorization, observability and failure handling.
Test the slice at component, API and integration levels; document deployment and migration impact.
quality_criteria: UI and service behavior agree on contracts.
Data changes are backward-compatible or migrated safely.
Critical user journey has reproducible end-to-end evidence.

stages.validation_method: Device testing and mobile release review.
stages.purpose: implement mobile behavior across device lifecycle and store constraints
execution_instructions: Inspect app lifecycle, navigation, state, networking and platform-specific conventions.
Implement permission prompts, secure local storage, offline/retry behavior and background lifecycle handling.
Test device sizes, OS versions, connectivity transitions and accessibility.
Validate signing/build configuration and store policy constraints without exposing signing secrets.
quality_criteria: App resumes and recovers from network/lifecycle changes.
Permissions are least-privilege and explained.
Supported OS/device matrix passes.

stages.validation_method: Consumer contract review and automated API tests.
stages.purpose: implement a versioned and testable API contract
execution_instructions: Implement route/resource semantics, schema validation and consistent error responses from the approved contract.
Enforce authentication, object-level authorization, rate limits and idempotency for side effects.
Handle pagination, filtering, version compatibility, timeouts and correlation IDs.
Run contract tests for success, invalid input, unauthorized access, boundary values and consumer compatibility.
quality_criteria: Implementation matches the published contract.
Auth and error cases are tested.
Breaking changes require version and migration approval.

inputs: logical data model and query requirements
stages.validation_method: DBA review and migration rehearsal.
stages.purpose: implement data access and schema evolution without integrity loss
execution_instructions: Implement constraints, indexes and parameterized queries based on observed access patterns.
Define transaction boundaries, isolation, concurrency and retry behavior.
Write forward and rollback/forward-fix migration scripts with pre/post checks.
Test data integrity, query plans and migration on representative volume.
quality_criteria: Constraints protect invariants.
Migration is repeatable and rehearsed.
Performance is measured against a representative workload.

stages.validation_method: Independent security review.
stages.purpose: implement identity proof and credential lifecycle securely
execution_instructions: Choose supported OIDC/OAuth/SAML flow based on client type and trust boundaries.

Corrective actions are verified for effectiveness.

Guardrails prevent local optimization harm.
Adopted process has an owner and review date.
